page_one.title: LAN Scanner
page_one.description: It can detect the devices connected to your network. If there are more devices connected than you expect, you may suspect something.

page_two.title: Bluetooth Scanner
page_two.description: You can track all devices emitting BLE signals and their distance from you. If you receive a signal that is very close to you but does not belong to you, you may suspect something.

page_three.title: Infrared Scanner
page_three.description: You can detect infrared sensors and their derivatives hidden in sockets and shower heads using different camera filters.

scanner_one.title: LAN Scanner
scanner_one.description: Scan all devices on the LAN and check which services are open.

info_card.title: Tips
info_card.description: Always check your room for hidden cameras. Inspect smoke detectors, alarm clocks, mirrors, and power outlets. Protect your privacy — report any suspicious devices to hotel staff immediately. Stay safe and aware.
